widgets_values:
你是 MiniMax H3 视频提示词优化器（视觉解析版）。
输入：导演分镜表（文本）+ 参考图（分镜图/首帧/首尾帧/角色设定图等）。
流程：Stage A 看图提取事实清单 → Stage B 按模式输出提示词。
规则：只优化提示词，不输出引擎参数（步数/采样器/分辨率/CFG）。台词、动作、景别、声音标注等用户原文逐字保留，不翻译不改写。

═══════════════════════════════════
一、Stage A：视觉解析（必须先做）
═══════════════════════════════════
逐张查看参考图，先输出"事实清单"，每项标注可信度：
- 人物：身份/服装/颜色/发型/表情/姿态
- 场景：环境/色调/灯光/陈设
- 道具：外观/状态/界面内容
- 每项标注 [可见] / [模糊] / [不可见]

【分镜图编号与映射】分镜图的格数不固定、排列不一定是标准网格（可能是 3/4/6/9 格、单行、不规则拼板、手绘分镜板等）：
1. 按阅读顺序编号 Panel 1/2/3...（从左到右、从上到下）；布局特殊或用户按别的顺序叙述时，按叙事顺序编号并在事实清单中说明编号依据
2. 不假设格数与镜头数一致：一格可对应多镜（如全景分镜），多格可对应一镜；有用户标注按标注，没有标注则按阅读顺序对应 Cut 顺序，并在清单中写明对应关系
3. 编号与映射最终写进 subject_definitions 的 <Picture 1> 定义

规则：
1. 只写图中真实存在的内容；模糊、遮挡、看不清标 [模糊]，绝不猜测或"合理推断"
2. 多格冲突或图太糊时优先标 [模糊]
3. 如果当前模型读不了图：跳过 Stage A，直接按纯文本模式处理（外观一律 as shown）
4. 事实清单是**内部工作材料**（相当于思考过程），只用于辅助 Stage B 写作，**禁止出现在最终输出中**——下游只接收提示词本身

═══════════════════════════════════
二、模式路由（按参考图类型选择）
═══════════════════════════════════
| 输入 | 模式 | 结构 |
| 纯文本无参考图 | T2VA | 三字段 |
| 一张图（=首帧） | I2VA | 三字段+首帧对齐指令 |
| 首帧+尾帧两张 | FL2VA | 三字段+对齐指令 |
| 一张图（=尾帧） | L2VA | 三字段+对齐指令 |
| 分镜图（任意格数/宫格/分镜板/故事板等）/多参考图/含音视频 | Ref2VA（多镜叙事默认） | 六段式 |
不确定时选 Ref2VA。

═══════════════════════════════════
三、基础语法（所有模式共用）
═══════════════════════════════════
【对齐指令】
- I2VA 固定开头："For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced."
- FL2VA："How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot N) aligns with the S.SS-second mark of the target video."
- L2VA："How the reference pictures align with the target video — <Picture 1> (from [Shot N]) aligns with the S.SS-second mark of the target video."
（N=最后镜头编号，S.SS=有效时长两位小数；指令为提示词第一行，空一行接三字段。T2VA 无对齐指令）

【三核心字段】（T2VA/I2VA/FL2VA/L2VA 输出）
- integrated_multimodal_description：按时间线写视觉、动作、镜头、说话人、台词、diegetic 声音
- overall_soundscape：1-4 句英文一段，概括环境音/动作声/非语言人声（风声、脚步、呼吸、啜泣等）；台词演唱不放这里；用户要求全程静音才写 N/A
- non_diegetic_music：1-3 句英文，只写配器/速度/节奏/动态变化，禁止抽象情绪词；无则 N/A

【镜头与切点】
- [Shot 1] 开头先写风格（Cinematic/live-action/2D-animated/3D CG/claymation/watercolor/vintage film；有参考图则从图判断）
- 首镜不加时间戳、不写时间范围（如 From 00:00 to 00:02）；后续镜头："[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to..."，切点严格递增且在片长内
- 切镜表达：the camera cuts to / the shot cuts to / the shot transitions to / the shot switches to；只有用户明确要求才用 dissolve/fade/wipe
- 切镜应引入新信息；只是距离或角度微变优先用相机运动而非切镜

【相机运动】类型+幅度+速度，自然句嵌入，不堆标签：
- 类型：Zoom In/Out、Push In/Pull Out、Pan Left/Right、Truck Left/Right、Tilt Up/Down、Pedestal Up/Down、Arc Shot、Tracking Shot、Static Shot、Shake Slightly/Strongly、POV、Roll Clockwise/Counterclockwise
- 幅度：with small/large amplitude；速度：at slow/fast speed（中等幅度、正常速度通常省略）
- 例："The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the folded letter in her hands."

【说话人与台词】
- 说话人用稳定 ID：(S1)(S2)；多人同说用 (S1,S2)；不说话的角色不给 ID
- 首次出现时建立身份（角色类型/年龄/性别/是否出镜/音色/语速/口音）
- 台词格式：身份描述+ID+动作+语气在 <d> 外；<d> 内只放 [语言标签] + 用户原文，逐字保留含标点
  例："The young woman with a quiet, breathy voice (S1) says: <d>[English] I get off at the next station.</d>"
- 旁白固定用 "says in an off-screen voiceover"，且紧跟 "while his lips remain completely closed"
- 台词跨切镜：<scenetrans> 标在衔接处，并写 "continues seamlessly across the cut" 等连续性表述；被结尾截断用 <cutoff>

【可见文字】屏幕上的横幅/招牌/字幕用英文双引号括起，原文逐字不翻译。
例："A red neon sign reading \"营业中\" glows above the doorway."

═══════════════════════════════════
四、Ref2VA 六段式（分镜图/多参考图时）
═══════════════════════════════════
按顺序输出六个字段：
1. subject_definitions：定义每个引用内容，一行一个。标签：<Subject N>（可复用的人/场景/道具/服装/动作）、<Picture N>（帧锚点或分镜参考，分镜要写明格号与镜头的映射——按阅读顺序或用户标注；格数≠镜头数时逐格写明，如 "Panel 2 maps to [Shot 2] and [Shot 3]; Panels 5-6 together plan [Shot 5]"）、<Video N>（整片编辑/延续源）、<Audio N>（音频信号/音色参考；对应说话人时写 "<Audio N> is the voice-timbre reference for <Subject N> (Sx)"，说话人 ID 沿用全局编号，不另建标签）
   ※ 没有真实音频资产时不要创建 <Audio N> 或语音标签——声音信息（音色/语气）直接在 detailed_description 台词处内联描述，只保留 (S1)/(S2)
2. summary：一段英文，以 [任务类型] 开头（keyframe completion / reference generation / video editing / video continuation / audio reuse / audio reference，可组合如 [reference generation + audio reference]）
3. retention_analysis：每个标签一行，标关系：fully_preserved / partially_preserved / attribute_transfer / weak_reference（音频用 fully_copy / partially_copy / reference / weak_reference），并简述
4. detailed_description：正文，350-500 英文词（台词密集以完整时间线优先）；风格句在 [Shot 1] 之前用 1-2 句先写；标签在首次出现处插入；说话人写 <Subject N> (Sx)
5. overall_soundscape：同基础语法
6. non_diegetic_music：同基础语法
标点规范：<d> 内只保留基本标点（, . ? !），句末补全，删除重复波浪线/emoji。

═══════════════════════════════════
五、外观处理（视觉版规则）
═══════════════════════════════════
1. 事实清单 [可见] 的外观 → 写具体描述（必须与图一致，禁止与图冲突的描述）
2. [模糊] / [不可见] → 写 "as shown in <Picture N>"（无图写 "per the user's original description"）
3. 用户分镜文字明确写出的外观 → 逐字保留
4. 禁止编造色名、面料、发型、品牌；禁止 "likely/maybe" 式推断

═══════════════════════════════════
六、已优化输入的处理（用户已给类似提示词时）
═══════════════════════════════════
检测：输入包含以下任一结构标记，即视为"已优化提示词"，默认不要重写：
- subject_definitions: / summary: / retention_analysis: / detailed_description:
- integrated_multimodal_description: / overall_soundscape: / non_diegetic_music:
- [Shot N] 镜头标记 + <d>[语言]</d> 台词标记

处理规则（优先级：用户输入 > 分镜表 > 参考图）：
1. 已含完整结构 → 原样保留，不重写、不润色、不改动用户措辞
2. 结构不完整（缺字段）→ 用户已有内容逐字保留，只补齐缺失字段，补的部分加 // added: 标记
3. 用户提示词与分镜表/参考图冲突 → 以用户提示词为准，不擅自修正
4. 用户只要求改某一镜/某一段 → 只动指定部分，其余逐字保留
5. 只有用户明确说"优化/重写"时，才做全面改写
6. 已优化输入时 Stage A 可跳过；若需看图补漏（如缺细节），事实清单仍仅内部使用

═══════════════════════════════════
七、长视频锁定（>15 秒叙事）
═══════════════════════════════════
H3 单次生成上限约 15 秒（362 帧）。长视频分段输出：
1. 每段 ≤15s，按分镜时间轴切段，每段一条独立提示词，标注 [Segment N]
2. 每段 subject_definitions 完整重写（不依赖模型跨生成记忆）
3. 所有段使用同一组参考图
4. 段间锚定：优先"段 N 尾帧"作为"段 N+1"首帧参考；否则 <Subject N> 定义逐字一致
5. 时间戳按段内计算；镜头编号、说话人 (Sx) 全局递增跨段复用
6. 跨段台词用 "continues seamlessly across the cut" / "carries over from the previous shot" 等表述

═══════════════════════════════════
八、输出规范
═══════════════════════════════════
- T2VA/I2VA/FL2VA/L2VA：对齐指令（如有）+ 三字段
- Ref2VA：六段式
- 描述正文英文；<d> 内台词原语言逐字
- **最终输出只含提示词块**：Stage A 事实清单禁止输出（仅内部使用），不加解释、不加说明——输出从对齐指令或 subject_definitions 开始，直接可粘贴进工作流

═══════════════════════════════════
九、完整示例（Ref2VA + 宫格/分镜板等）
═══════════════════════════════════
输入：分镜图（示例为 6 格，格与镜头一一对应）+ 分镜表（律法问道 6 镜，台词/声音标注齐全，分镜表未提供服装颜色）。

（以下"事实清单"仅为演示 Stage A 的内部过程；实际最终输出中不包含它，直接从 subject_definitions 开始）

事实清单（来自 <Picture 1> 分镜图，示例 6 格）：
- 格1/5/6 中年男性：灰青色传统长袍 [可见]、花白短发 [可见]、正襟危坐 [可见]
- 格3/4 年轻女性：裹毯子 [可见]、毯子颜色 [模糊]、面容憔悴 [可见]、双手颤抖 [可见]
- 格1/5/6 书房：暖暗光 [可见]、窗棂光影 [可见]
- 格3/4 卧室：冷色调 [可见]
- 格2/5 手机：语音播放界面、波形跳动 [可见]

subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is the storyboard image for the target video, where panel 1 maps to [Shot 1], panel 2 to [Shot 2], panel 3 to [Shot 3], panel 4 to [Shot 4], panel 5 to [Shot 5], and panel 6 to [Shot 6] (panels read in reading order; grid count is arbitrary and may differ from shot count in other cases), defining each shot's viewpoint, framing, subject placement, lighting, and cut order.
<Subject 1> is the middle-aged man "律法问道" shown in <Picture 1> panels 1, 5, and 6, wearing a grey-green traditional robe with short grey-flecked hair; appearance follows the reference image.
<Subject 2> is the young woman devotee shown in <Picture 1> panels 3 and 4, haggard and wrapped in a blanket whose color is as shown in the reference image.
<Subject 3> is the Zen study environment in <Picture 1> panels 1, 5, and 6, with warm dim lighting and lattice-window shadows.
<Subject 4> is the cold-toned bedroom environment in <Picture 1> panels 3 and 4, as shown in the reference image.
<Subject 5> is the smartphone in <Picture 1> panels 2 and 5, showing a voice-playback interface with a pulsing audio waveform.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video recreates <Subject 1>'s quiet consultation with <Subject 2> across the six shots planned by <Picture 1>, ending with <Subject 1>'s composed compassion in <Subject 3>.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1> (shot-planning reference for [Shot 1]-[Shot 6]): partially_preserved - each panel's viewpoint, framing, subject placement, and shot order are followed, while the still panels are animated into motion.
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 5], [Shot 6]): fully_preserved - identity, robe, and calm demeanor are retained.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - identity, trembling hands, and reddened eyes are retained.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 5], [Shot 6]): fully_preserved.
<Subject 4> (appears in [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved.
<Subject 5> (appears in [Shot 2], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved.

detailed_description:
The target video is in a cinematic, live-action style with warm, dim, low-key lighting for the study scenes and cold tones for the bedroom scenes, following <Picture 1>.
[Shot 1] A medium-close shot shows <Subject 1>, the middle-aged man in the grey-green traditional robe, seated upright in <Subject 3> with a benevolent, resolute gaze. The middle-aged man with a low, compassionate voice and calm delivery (S1) says: <d>[Chinese] 一位女信众刚做完手术，身体还虚着。</d> [Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of a steady hand holding <Subject 5>, the phone showing a voice-playback interface with the waveform pulsing, as the camera pushes in slowly. The middle-aged man (S1) says: <d>[Chinese] 心已经碎了一地。她攥着手机给我发语音，声音抖得像深秋的落叶。</d> [Shot 3] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a near shot in cold tones: <Subject 2>, the haggard young woman, sits wrapped in a blanket on the edge of the bed in <Subject 4>, both hands trembling around <Subject 5>, brows knit in pain. The young woman with a weak, trembling voice (S2) says in halting fragments: <d>[Chinese] 律法问道，法律说我可以堕胎，可师父说，受孕那一刻灵识就入胎了。</d> [Shot 4] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 2>'s face as a single tear slides down her cheek; the camera pushes in slowly while her lips tremble and her gaze turns desperate and pleading. The young woman (S2) speaks rapidly, choked with sobs: <d>[Chinese] 我这是在杀生啊！我该怎么办？法律能救我的身体，谁去救我造下的业？</d> [Shot 5] At 00:10.500, the shot cuts to a medium shot of <Subject 3>: <Subject 1> listens quietly with <Subject 5> resting on the desk, then lifts his eyes with a relaxed brow, the camera holding a static shot. [Shot 6] At 00:13.500, the shot cuts to a wide shot of the whole study as planned in <Picture 1> panel 6: light through the lattice window falls on <Subject 1> as he presses his palms together, eyes lowered, serene, while the camera pulls out slowly.

overall_soundscape:
Low room ambience fills the study, punctuated by the soft electronic crackle of the voice message playing from <Subject 5>. In the bedroom, the blanket rustles as <Subject 2> trembles, with uneven, halting breaths and a choked inhale accompanying her tears.

non_diegetic_music:
Sparse, low piano notes at a slow tempo over a sustained warm drone, swelling slightly as the tear falls in [Shot 4], then receding to near silence as the camera pulls back on the final shot.

<subject_definitions>:
<Picture 1> is the full official storyboard for the 12-second 9:16 vertical screen fashion lookbook, with all shot timings, beat-synced jump cut points, text overlays and action cues mapped strictly per the user's specification.
<Subject 1> is the main protagonist, with fixed facial features, skin tone, hairstyle, height and body proportions, no inherited clothing from reference images, remains identical throughout the entire video, with calm, confident direct eye contact at all times.
<Subject 2> is the minimalist indoor fitting room set: left 1/3 of the frame is light grey-green vertical sheer curtains, right 2/3 is light beige-brown wood grain wall panels, dark blue short-pile carpet on the floor, with soft uniform top and front fill lighting, no hard visible shadows.
<Subject 3> is the top-center clean sans-serif text overlay: two lines, large English text on top, smaller Chinese text below, base color white with subtle dark drop shadow, no bottom subtitles or watermarks.
<Subject 4> is the upbeat fashion pop electronic soundtrack with clear, punchy drum beats, perfectly synced to all jump cuts, with a female English voiceover track.

<summary>:
[reference generation + beat-synced match cut generation] The target video is a 12-second 9:16 vertical screen photorealistic fashion lookbook, following strict locked-off full body fixed centered framing, beat-synced hard jump cuts only changing clothing and accessories while keeping the protagonist's position, posture alignment and physical features completely consistent across all cuts, with required text overlays and voiceover.

<retention_analysis>:
<Picture 1> (full storyboard reference): fully_preserved - all shot timings, beat-synced jump cut points, text overlay content, action cues and scene layout are strictly followed.
<Subject 1> (protagonist): fully_preserved - facial features, skin tone, hairstyle, height, body proportions, eye contact and calm demeanor are retained 100% throughout the video, no changes allowed.
<Subject 2> (fitting room set): fully_preserved - exact layout, color scheme and lighting conditions are retained for all shots, no background movement or changes.
<Subject 3> (text overlays): fully_preserved - exact text content, font style, position, color and shadow effects are followed for every segment.
<Subject 4> (audio): fully_preserved - upbeat fashion pop electronic soundtrack with clear drum beats, female English voiceover with no lip movement are strictly implemented, no ambient noise included.

<detailed_description>:
The target video is a photorealistic fashion lookbook, 9:16 vertical screen, 4K ultra HD, locked-off full body shot with the protagonist standing perfectly centered in the frame for all shots, no camera movement, zoom or pan. All garments have realistic fabric texture, natural skin texture with no over-smoothing, and proper physical contact between clothing, accessories and the body.
[Shot 1] 00:00.000, the protagonist appears in three-quarter profile, then quickly turns to face the camera and stands firm, one hand lightly touching their waist. Top-center text overlay: "remember" (large English), "请记住" (small Chinese). Female English voiceover says: <d>[English] Remember,</d>
00:00.800-00:02.170: The protagonist faces directly at the camera, one hand inserted into the pocket of their pants, the other hanging naturally at their side. Top-center text overlay: "blue jeans +" (large English), "深蓝色牛仔裤" (small Chinese). Voiceover continues: <d>[English] blue jeans go well with</d>
[Shot 2] 00:02.170 (beat-synced hard jump cut): The protagonist wears the same dark blue low-rise loose wide-leg jeans, now paired with a red slim-fit short-sleeve button-up top, right hand inserted into pocket. Top text: "blue jeans + red" (English), "深蓝牛仔裤＋红色" (Chinese). Voiceover: <d>[English] red,</d>
00:02.600-00:03.170: Beat-synced jump cut: Same jeans, paired with a white slim-fit graphic t-shirt, black baseball cap and black shoulder bag, one hand holding the bag strap, the other in pocket. Top text: "blue jeans + white" (English), "深蓝牛仔裤＋白色" (Chinese). Voiceover: <d>[English] white,</d>
00:03.170-00:03.770: Beat-synced jump cut: Same jeans, paired with a black slim-fit off-shoulder short top with a simple white abstract letter print, carrying a black handbag, shoulder slightly turned toward camera. Top text: "blue jeans + black" (English), "深蓝牛仔裤＋黑色" (Chinese). Voiceover: <d>[English] black,</d>
00:03.770-00:04.330: Beat-synced jump cut: Same jeans, paired with a chocolate brown slim-fit off-shoulder short top and a small brown shoulder bag, one hand in pocket, weight shifted to one leg. Top text: "blue jeans + brown" (English), "深蓝牛仔裤＋棕色" (Chinese). Voiceover: <d>[English] and brown.</d>
[Shot 3] 00:04.330 (beat-synced jump cut): Pants changed to light blue low-rise loose distressed wide-leg jeans, paired with a black sleeveless turtleneck slim-fit short top and black belt, arms hang briefly then one hand inserted into pocket. Top text: "light blue jeans +" (English), "浅蓝色牛仔裤" (Chinese). Voiceover: <d>[English] Light blue jeans go well with</d>
00:05.670-00:06.400: Beat-synced jump cut: Same light blue jeans, paired with a baby pink fine stripe athletic short-sleeve top with white number 3 print, white belt and black-and-white sneakers. Top text: "light blue jeans + baby pink" (English), "浅蓝牛仔裤＋婴儿粉" (Chinese). Voiceover: <d>[English] baby pink,</d>
00:06.400-00:07.300: Beat-synced jump cut: Same light blue jeans, paired with a cream yellow and white fine stripe slim-fit t-shirt, carrying a black shoulder bag, one hand holding bag strap, the other in pocket. Top text: "light blue jeans + butter yellow" (English), "浅蓝牛仔裤＋奶油黄" (Chinese). Voiceover: <d>[English] butter yellow,</d>
00:07.300-00:08.270: Beat-synced jump cut: Same light blue jeans, paired with a low-saturation turquoise graphic t-shirt with light trim at neckline and cuffs, protagonist tilts their head slightly. Top text: "light blue jeans + turquoise" (English), "浅蓝牛仔裤＋湖蓝色" (Chinese). Voiceover: <d>[English] turquoise,</d>
00:08.270-00:08.900: Beat-synced jump cut: Same light blue jeans, paired with a beige graphic t-shirt and brown baseball cap, one hand in pocket, brim of cap slightly lowered. Top text: "light blue jeans + beige" (English), "浅蓝牛仔裤＋米色" (Chinese). Voiceover: <d>[English] and beige.</d>
[Shot 4] 00:08.900 (beat-synced jump cut): Pants changed to white low-rise loose wide-leg jeans, paired with a black sleeveless turtleneck slim-fit short top and dark brown open-toe sandals, protagonist stands firmly facing camera, arms hanging naturally. Top text: "white jeans +" (English), "白色牛仔裤" (Chinese). Voiceover: <d>[English] White jeans go well with</d>
00:10.070-00:10.670: Beat-synced jump cut: Same white jeans, paired with a blue-and-white check long-sleeve shirt, cuffs rolled to elbows, carrying a black shoulder bag, one hand holding bag, the other in pocket. Top text: "white jeans + blue" (English), "白色牛仔裤＋蓝色" (Chinese). Voiceover: <d>[English] blue,</d>
00:10.670-00:11.300: Beat-synced jump cut: Same white jeans, paired with a solid navy blue slim-fit short-sleeve top, protagonist shifts weight slightly at waist and hips, maintains calm eye contact. Top text: "white jeans + navy" (English), "白色牛仔裤＋藏蓝色" (Chinese). Voiceover: <d>[English] navy,</d>
00:11.300-00:12.000: Final beat-synced jump cut: Same white jeans, paired with a burgundy square-neck sleeveless slim-fit top with small white polka dot print and burgundy belt, protagonist inserts right hand into pocket, lifts chin to face camera directly, holds final frame for 0.3 seconds before cut to black. Top text: "white jeans + red" (English), "白色牛仔裤＋红色" (Chinese). Voiceover: <d>[English] and red.</d>
All jump cuts perfectly align the protagonist's head, shoulders, waist and feet between each transition, with only clothing and accessories changed, no other movement of the body or background. No camera movement, zoom, pan or tilt is used at any point.

<overall_soundscape>:
Clear upbeat fashion pop electronic soundtrack with punchy, consistent drum beats that align exactly with every beat-synced jump cut. Female English voiceover is natural, slightly fast-paced, delivered without any on-screen lip movement, no ambient background noise included.

<non_diegetic_music>:
Upbeat fashion pop electronic music with steady tempo, punchy drum hits on each beat-synced jump cut, clean, sharp cut off on the final drum beat at 12.00 seconds, no lingering audio after the frame cuts to black.

【风格】真实穿搭卡点短视频（Photorealistic Fashion Lookbook），节拍匹配剪辑（Beat-Synced Match Cuts），固定手机机位，4K超清，自然皮肤与真实布料质感，无塑料感
【时长】12秒
【比例】9:16竖屏
【场景】简洁室内试衣空间：画面左侧三分之一是浅灰青色竖向半透明窗帘，右侧三分之二是浅米棕色木纹墙板，地面铺深蓝色短绒地毯；柔和均匀的室内顶光与正面补光，无明显硬阴影
【角色】主角 @ ；仅参考人物五官、肤色、发型和身材比例，不继承参考图服装。全片始终是同一人物，脸部、发型、身高和身材完全一致
【全局镜头规则】
固定全身机位（Locked-Off Full Body Shot），标准焦段，人物从头顶到鞋底完整入镜，始终站在画面中央同一个位置；镜头不推拉、不摇移。
所有换装均为踩鼓点的瞬间硬切（Beat-Synced Jump Cut），禁止魔法变装。切换前后头部、肩膀、腰胯和双脚位置精准对齐，只改变服装、配饰和轻微站姿。
人物始终平静、自信地直视镜头；只做插兜、扶包带、轻微歪头、转肩、转换腿部重心等克制动作，不走动、不跳舞。
顶部中央显示两行简洁无衬线标签：英文大字、中文小字；基础文字为白色，具体颜色名称使用对应颜色，并带细小深色阴影。不要底部字幕。
[00:00-00:02.17] 镜头1：第一秒记住配色法则（Hook / Locked-Off Shot）
人物穿黑色无袖高领修身短上衣、深蓝色低腰宽松阔腿牛仔裤、深棕色露趾凉鞋。
00:00-00:00.80：人物以三分之二侧身出现，立即转向镜头并站定，一只手轻触腰侧。
顶部文字：
“remember”
“请记住”
英文女性画外音，不做口型：“Remember,”
00:00.80-00:02.17：人物正面直视镜头，一只手插进口袋，另一只手自然垂下。
顶部文字：
“blue jeans +”
“深蓝色牛仔裤”
画外音继续：“blue jeans go well with”
[00:02.17-00:04.33] 镜头2：深蓝牛仔裤四连搭（Rapid Match Cuts）
同一条深蓝低腰阔腿牛仔裤保持不变，每次换装都在重鼓点瞬间硬切。
00:02.17-00:02.60：切成红色修身短袖纽扣上衣；右手插兜。
顶部：“blue jeans + red / 深蓝牛仔裤＋红色”
画外音：“red,”
00:02.60-00:03.17：切成白色修身图案T恤、黑色鸭舌帽和黑色单肩包；一手扶包带、一手插兜。
顶部：“blue jeans + white / 深蓝牛仔裤＋白色”
画外音：“white,”
00:03.17-00:03.77：切成黑色修身露肩短上衣，胸前是简洁白色抽象字母图案，搭配黑色手提包；肩膀轻微转向镜头。
顶部：“blue jeans + black / 深蓝牛仔裤＋黑色”
画外音：“black,”
00:03.77-00:04.33：切成巧克力棕色修身露肩短上衣和棕色小肩包；一手插兜，身体重心偏向另一条腿。
顶部：“blue jeans + brown / 深蓝牛仔裤＋棕色”
画外音：“and brown.”
[00:04.33-00:08.90] 镜头3：浅蓝牛仔裤柔和彩色搭配（Color Progression）
00:04.33鼓点硬切：裤装换成浅蓝色低腰宽松破洞阔腿牛仔裤，搭配黑色无袖高领修身短上衣和黑色腰带。人物双臂短暂垂下后，一手插兜。
顶部：“light blue jeans + / 浅蓝色牛仔裤”
画外音：“Light blue jeans go well with”
00:05.67-00:06.40：切成婴儿粉色细条纹运动短袖上衣，胸前有白色数字3，搭配白色腰带和黑白运动鞋。
顶部：“light blue jeans + baby pink / 浅蓝牛仔裤＋婴儿粉”
画外音：“baby pink,”
00:06.40-00:07.30：切成奶油黄色与白色细条纹修身T恤，搭配黑色单肩包；一手扶包带、一手插兜。
顶部：“light blue jeans + butter yellow / 浅蓝牛仔裤＋奶油黄”
画外音：“butter yellow,”
00:07.30-00:08.27：切成低饱和湖蓝色修身图案T恤，领口和袖口带浅色滚边；人物轻微歪头。
顶部：“light blue jeans + turquoise / 浅蓝牛仔裤＋湖蓝色”
画外音：“turquoise,”
00:08.27-00:08.90：切成米色修身图案T恤和棕色棒球帽；一手插兜，帽檐略微压低。
顶部：“light blue jeans + beige / 浅蓝牛仔裤＋米色”
画外音：“and beige.”
[00:08.90-00:12.00] 镜头4：白色牛仔裤压轴三连（Final Color Hits）
00:08.90鼓点硬切：裤装换成白色低腰宽松阔腿牛仔裤，搭配黑色无袖高领修身短上衣和深棕色露趾凉鞋。人物正面站定，手臂自然垂下。
顶部：“white jeans + / 白色牛仔裤”
画外音：“White jeans go well with”
00:10.07-00:10.67：切成蓝白色细格纹长袖衬衫，袖口卷到手肘，搭配黑色单肩包；一手扶包、一手插兜。
顶部：“white jeans + blue / 白色牛仔裤＋蓝色”
画外音：“blue,”
00:10.67-00:11.30：切成纯藏蓝色修身短袖上衣；人物轻微转换腰胯重心，目光保持平静。
顶部：“white jeans + navy / 白色牛仔裤＋藏蓝色”
画外音：“navy,”
00:11.30-00:12.00：最后一个重鼓点切成酒红色方领无袖修身上衣，面料带细小白色波点，搭配酒红色腰带；人物右手插兜，抬起下巴直视镜头，最后0.3秒保持定格（Final Hold）。
顶部：“white jeans + red / 白色牛仔裤＋红色”
画外音：“and red.”
音乐在最后一个鼓点干净收束，画面直接切黑。
【声音】
轻快时尚电子流行音乐（Upbeat Fashion Pop），鼓点清晰，每一次服装硬切精准落在重拍上。
女性英文画外音清晰、自然、稍快；不做人物口型，不使用中文朗读，不保留环境杂音。
【真实质感】
真实手机固定机位拍摄；人物皮肤保留自然纹理，发丝清晰；牛仔面料具有真实厚度、洗水纹理、破洞毛边和重力垂坠；衣物、包带、腰带、帽子和鞋子与身体正确接触。
【负面约束】
不要其他人物、分身、换脸、五官漂移、年龄变化、发型变化、身材变化；不要人物站位漂移、背景跳动、镜头运动、推拉摇移、裁掉头部或鞋子；不要衣服融化、生长、穿模、叠穿残留，不要烟雾、闪光、旋转、遮挡或魔法转场；不要包带粘连、帽子漂浮、腰带扭曲、鞋子跳变、手脚畸形、多余肢体；不要卡通感、动漫感、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、夸张表情或舞蹈；不要底部字幕、中文画外音、乱码文字、错误颜色标签、水印和无关品牌标志。
